# Socket.IO client (vendored)

CrysViz vendors the minified Socket.IO 4.7.5 ESM client used by the optional
backend panel so normal viewer startup does not depend on a CDN. The file is
the unmodified upstream distribution from:

https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/socket.io/4.7.5/socket.io.esm.min.js

Socket.IO is released under the MIT license; see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).
